label: Deblock
blurb: Smooths away the square blocks a starved video stream leaves in skies, walls and dark scenes, the way a decoder's loop filter does: it only softens the step across each block border when both sides are flat and the step is small, so real edges and texture stay sharp. Block size is 8 for most streams; for a clip that was made bigger after it was compressed, multiply (720p shown at 1080p is 12). Show the grid to line it up.
